message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters and strips the combining marks before calling the vendored `slugify`. I didn't edit `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say vendored code must not be hand-edited.

The shop's `src/shop/product-url.js` also uses the vendored `slugify` and still drops accented letters from product names. I left it alone because the task was about blog URLs. If you want product URLs fixed too, the same one-line change would work there.

I haven't committed anything.
